class.name: TriggerButton
class.description: RQt plugin with a large button that calls a std_srvs/Trigger service.

qtgui.label: Service Trigger Button
qtgui.statustip: A large touch-friendly button calling a std_srvs/Trigger service, e.g. to start or stop a robot mission.

class.name: PushButton
class.description: RQt plugin with a large button that calls a std_srvs/SetBool service, with true while the button is held and false once it is released.

qtgui.label: Service Push Button
qtgui.statustip: A large touch-friendly button calling std_srvs/SetBool with true when pushed and false when released.
